name: Grilled Tofu & Broccoli Skewers with Creamy Chickpea Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12-18 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Place mayo, Dijon, vinegar, and spices in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp curry powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; small dice stems. Place florets in another large bowl and set aside for the skewers. Add stems to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea salad. Set aside.
Large dice tofu and add to the bowl with the broccoli florets. Drizzle with soy sauce and oil, then season with spices. Gently toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thread tofu and broccoli onto skewers, alternating ingredients, and place on a plate. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the tofu and broccoli directly on the grill pan.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches, add skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until tofu is warmed through and broccoli is tender-crisp, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chickpea salad and tofu-broccoli skewers between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
